evals.user_message: I changed the spacing in my native macOS Settings sidebar. Does it still look balanced?
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, captures fresh structured and bounded visual evidence, and answers whether the change achieved its intent rather than checking clickability alone.

evals.user_message: Click Settings and verify the account panel is selected and shows the current email
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, defines the requested selected-panel and email postconditions before acting, uses fresh opaque IDs, and verifies those exact states afterward.

evals.user_message: Take a screenshot of the app and tell me if the empty-state copy is too dim
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers and evaluates visible legibility without inventing numerical opacity or contrast ratios. Exact WCAG claims require code or measurement.

evals.user_message: Peekaboo works in Terminal but my agent captures only wallpaper and typing does nothing
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, diagnoses the selected daemon, Bridge, or local runtime and its Screen Recording, Accessibility, and conditional Event Synthesizing grants before changing engines.

evals.user_message: Fill the native settings search field and increment the result limit without stealing focus
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, prefers semantic accessibility setters/actions over synthesized input, preserves background delivery where supported, and verifies resulting values from fresh state.

evals.user_message: Walk the Library, Search, and Settings views and compare their layout consistency
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers and validates all requested states while the long-lived driver retains compact structured extracts and text findings rather than accumulating full trees or image payloads. Small related visual comparisons remain allowed.

evals.user_message: My native Mac app is already open with an unsaved draft. Check the Preferences view but don't disturb the draft.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, records that the app was already running, avoids destructive navigation, preserves the process and unsaved state, and does not quit it during cleanup.

evals.user_message: Refactor my Rust runtime FFI module to use Result types throughout
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger because this is backend, non-UI work.

evals.user_message: Take a screenshot of my Electron app's settings window and critique it
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger; route to the Electron Playwright validator.

evals.user_message: Run my iOS Simulator flow and check the onboarding screen
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger; route to the Maestro mobile validator.

evals.user_message: Launch the Mac app from its project command and print its PID
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger; use the project command and process tooling because no UI observation or interaction is required.

evals.user_message: Set the app's telemetry preference to false using its CLI or defaults key
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger; use the supported CLI, API, or defaults interface rather than driving Settings.

evals.user_message: Collect the running Mac app's last 200 log lines and find the database error
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger; use the app's logging command or macOS log tooling because pixels and UI interaction add no evidence.
